input.query: WITH c AS (SELECT trace_id, span_id, duration FROM abnormal_traces WHERE service_name='search' AND span_name='geo.Geo/Nearby' AND attr_span_kind='Client') SELECT (c.trace_id IN (SELECT trace_id FROM abnormal_traces WHERE service_name='geo' AND attr_span_kind='Server')) has_geo_server, count(*) n, approx_quantile(c.duration/1e6,0.5) med_ms, approx_quantile(c.duration/1e6,0.95) p95_ms, min(c.duration/1e6) mn, max(c.duration/1e6) mx FROM c GROUP BY 1

WITH c AS (SELECT trace_id, span_id, duration FROM normal_traces WHERE service_name='search' AND span_name='geo.Geo/Nearby' AND attr_span_kind='Client') SELECT (c.trace_id IN (SELECT trace_id FROM normal_traces WHERE service_name='geo' AND attr_span_kind='Server')) has_geo_server, count(*) n, approx_quantile(c.duration/1e6,0.5) med_ms, approx_quantile(c.duration/1e6,0.95) p95_ms FROM c GROUP BY 1
